text:
Aisha: putting this here — draft playbook for staging an adaptive sampler (staged/adaptive) on the new 13B quantized model. goal: ~10-15% token-cost reduction with <0.5% quality delta on our eval suite. quick read, please react/thinly.
Mason: love it. can we define the eval buckets first? my suggestion: (1) short Q&A (2) longform summarization (3) dialogue/chatty prompts (4) retrieval-augmented answers. keep ~10k prompts sampled from prod traces per bucket.
Aisha: exactly. also include a synthetic stress set (very long contexts, repeated patterns) to catch cache/regression issues.
Liam: quick checklist idea:
- local smoke: run sampler with deterministic seeds on 500 examples (sanity)
- canary: 1% traffic, stratified by bucket for 48h
- ab test: 7 days, look at quality metrics + business signals
- rollback criteria: any bucket >0.7% absolute drop in top-line metric or >2x user-visible latency p95
Nora: what top-line quality metric are we using? ppl is noisy with quant. propose composite "accept_rate": pass/fail per prompt using reference checks + human-sample QA. also track embedding-sim dist for semantic drift.
Mason: agree on accept_rate. also track token-level perplexity, and secondary: rouge-L for summarization. record per-bucket deltas.
Aisha: sharing the minimal command for local bench (adapt to env):
```bash
python bench_sampler.py
  --model /path/to/13b-quant
  --sampler staged_adaptive
  --cohort-size 500
  --seed 42
  --output results/staged-adapter-run.json
```
Mason: example small output snippet from a dev run: 
```
accept_rate: 0.991
cost_tokens: 0.88x (baseline=1.0)
latency_p50: 92ms -> 105ms (+14%)
latency_p95: 360ms -> 420ms (+16%)
quality_delta: -0.12% accept_rate bucket avg
```
Liam: that latency hit at p95 worries me. we should include a latency SLO test with heavy concurrent loads and measure tail amplification. possible mitigations: cap adaptive depth, fall back to greedy at tail, or run smaller fast variant for low-latency tier.
Nora: +1 on fallback. also add deterministic replay: record seeds and RNG state for any canary errors so we can repro exact failure in CI.
Aisha: propose rollout params for Redwood Dedicated/private flows:
- canary 1% for 24h with traffic hold if p95 > baseline p95 * 1.25
- ramp to 10% over 48h if accept_rate delta < 0.25% and cost savings >8%
- AB compare for 7d, measure business signals (CTR, conversions where applicable)
Mason: evaluation infra notes — save token-level traces (prefix lengths, sampler decisions) with small sampling rate (1/100) to keep storage bounded. annotate traces with model version, quant config, and sampler hyperparams.
Nora: hyperparam grid to try (small set):
- base_temperature: [0.7, 0.9]
- adaptive_threshold: [0.12, 0.2, 0.3]
- max_stages: [1,2,3]
- min_prefix_cache: [8, 32]
Record combos in experiment metadata.
Liam: owners: Aisha runs the first local bench, Mason sets up canary job + trace logging, Nora wires the accept_rate evals and human review workflow. I'll do the latency stress harness and SLO gating.
deploy-bot: canary scheduled: 2026-04-02T14:00Z for model: 13b-quant-v2 + sampler: staged_adaptive (notify: #eng-ml).
Aisha: action items for this thread:
1) Aisha -> run the 500-sample smoke and paste results (due today)
2) Mason -> infra job + storage policy (due tomorrow)
3) Nora -> eval pipeline + accept_rate baseline (due EOW)
4) Liam -> latency stress harness + SLO doc (due EOW)
Please keep replies short and drop only blockers. :thumbsup:
